summary: The filing is a routine Form 6-K portfolio update by Elemental Royalty Corp. It provides operational progress on its royalty assets (Karlawinda, Laverton, Viscaria, Diablillos, Mactung, Bonikro, etc.) including commissioning timelines, feasibility studies, and operator changes. There is no transaction being executed, no board recommendation, no deal structure, and no price or premium disclosed. The filing is a standard current report on Form 6-K with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. Therefore, no special situation category applies.
